messages:
mira-cs: quick flag  four trial accounts reported lower-quality embeddings + sporadic 502s during bulk-imports after the early-morning runtime change. two are in late-stage renewal. tagging eng/sre and sales.

dan-eng: investigating. initial repro shows a decode stall under sustained 5k+ item batches with new quantized weights.

lee-sre: opened INC-2026-999; applying temporary soft-throttle to bulk-import queues and routing heavy jobs to standby nodes. monitoring now.

status-bot: Incident INC-2026-999 | priority: medium-high | status: mitigating | link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-999

mira-cs: CS needs a short customer note: impact, what were doing now, data safety, ETA window, and gesture. keep it one paragraph.

dan-eng: suggested tech blurb: "Cause: decode stall in quantized model during very large batches. Mitigation: throttling and standby routing; rebuild artifact underway." ETA for validated artifact: 36-72 hours. rollback possible earlier.

ashley-legal: wording: use "no customer data loss or exfiltration detected." avoid promising under-24h deadlines. also note retention: save outbound comms in incident drive.

mira-cs: draft for targeted emails below. will send to 4 trial contacts + post portal status once eng + legal signoff.

mira-cs: ```Hi <Name>,

We observed reduced embedding relevance and occasional 502 errors for some high-volume bulk-import requests after a runtime update deployed this morning. Our engineers have implemented temporary throttling and are validating a rebuilt model artifact. We do not detect any customer data loss or exfiltration. We expect a validated mitigation within 36-72 hours and will notify you sooner if we rollback or complete the fix earlier.

As a courtesy for the disruption, we will apply a one-time account credit for impacted onboarding usage and offer a priority technical review to tune ingest parameters for your workload. Reply to reserve a slot.

Thank you,
Redwood Inference Support```

lee-sre: portal status suggestion: "throttling applied; artifact rebuild in progress; monitoring success & relevance metrics."

ben-sales: looping AEs for the two renewal accounts. please DM me per-account error deltas + timeline so I can prep outreach.

dan-eng: will DM charts and selected traces in ~20m and push an e2e test to catch large-batch stalls.

mira-cs: plan recap: 1) eng signoff on draft 2) targeted emails + portal post 3) apply credits + book review calls 4) collect feedback on renewal sentiment and hand off a 1-page summary to sales 5) full RCA within 72h.

ashley-legal: confirmed retention note; CS please upload sent copies to cs-incident-archive.

lee-sre: mitigation stable after 30m; expanding rollback window to more clusters for observation.

mira-cs: thanks team. sending after portal post goes live. will capture customer reactions for the renewal risk tracker.
